facts.fact: 断水：Lucas 让出最后一皮囊水（只剩几滴）；两天没遇到人
facts.anchor: “You take the rest.” Lucas handed her the last waterskin.

facts.fact: 魔法规则：不能无中生水；凭空变的水会吸干细胞成干壳
facts.anchor: I can’t summon water from nothing. There has to be a water source for me to pull from.

facts.fact: 草中灰手突袭拽倒 Lucas——多只残手拖入深草
facts.anchor: A shriveled gray hand shot from the grass and took hold of Lucas’s ankle, yanking him to the ground.

facts.fact: 她拔箭狂刺草手——黑血溅脸手松开；箭只剩两支小腿红肿
facts.anchor: She yanked two arrows free and stabbed the desperate hands dragging them backward.

facts.fact: 翻丘发现营地：两帐篷+篷车围篝火——卖艺人营地
facts.anchor: two worn tents and a covered wagon creating a semi-circle around a blazing fire

facts.fact: Lucas 立纪律：别让人知道你是女巫——怕或利用
facts.anchor: Do not let them know you’re a witch. Most people are either fearful of magic or will try to use you for it.

facts.fact: Hachar 持刀拦路；Lucas 报名谈旅行协议去 Traveler's Inn
facts.anchor: “I’m Lucas of the Southern Woods. This is my cousin, Andra, of the same woods.”

facts.fact: Jasper 出场：让"女的"用身体抵账——她强忍不适不缩
facts.anchor: “I can think of a way for the female to pay her dues,” a lazy voice drawled from the trees behind the camp.

facts.fact: Marie 冲出救场：骂野蛮人、擦血、领进大篷车换衣
facts.anchor: “How dare you boys treat a lady like this!” An older woman rushed out from behind the wagon

facts.fact: Marie 自述：流动表演团；Hachar 安排怪物斗殴（商人收/村里存/野外捕）
facts.anchor: “Well, Hachar has been in charge since he started traveling ages ago. He arranges monster fights.”

facts.fact: Jasper 飞刀贴耳示威"还有别的本事"；她正面回击拒绝
facts.anchor: the dagger whizzing close enough to her ear to move her hair as it flew by, sticking in a tree behind her.

facts.fact: 主题句：混蛋名声不是碰别人身体的许可证——Marie 答完全对
facts.anchor: “Having the reputation of an asshole doesn’t give a person the right to another’s body,” she said stiffly.
